# Introductory Widget Law (fictional), Fall 2026

Instructor: Prof. Quill. Casebook: Widgets and Wares, 4th ed.

## Schedule
1. Formation and the writing requirement
2. Performance, breach, and remedies for sellers and buyers
3. Excuse doctrines
4. Damages and limits on damages

## Assessment
The final exam is closed book. As announced at the start of the semester, it combines multiple choice questions with one or two essay questions. Grades are curved.
